hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q "git commit"; then repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$repo_root" ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "$repo_root" || exit 0; if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE '^(src/Gantry\.Api/|tests/Gantry\.Api\.Tests/)'; then (cd tests/Gantry.Api.Tests && dotnet test) || { echo "Gantry.Api.Tests failed - commit blocked. Fix failing tests before committing." >&2; exit 2; }; fi; fi
